title: Jesus' burial
description: Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for Jesus' body and, together with Nicodemus, laid it in a new tomb cut out of the rock. A large stone was rolled in front of the entrance, and the chief priests had Pilate secure the tomb with guards and a seal.
